'''Darva''' was a [[Biituian]] who lived in a village on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Biitu]] during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
When an Imperial [[Starship/Legends|starship]] arrived, bringing the [[Great Heep]] to establish a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation, she fled as the Imperials triggered a large storm which uprooted [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and sucked all water from the nearby river. With the construction of the "[[moisture eater]]," a tower that drained all moisture from the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], Darva was forced to live through a drought which threatened the lives of all the natives. However, they were eventually saved due to the actions of [[Mungo Baobab]] and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].

==Behind the scenes==
Darva was created by [[Ben Burtt]] for the [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars Droids'']] TV special ''[[The Great Heep]]'', in which she was voiced by [[Melleny Brown]].
